subject: Landlord refusing to return deposit
body:
Hello,

I'm hoping you can help. I rented a flat at 14 Elm Court, Reading RG1 4PQ for two years and moved out last month. My landlord, a Mr Derek Fenn, is refusing to return my deposit of £1,450 and is claiming damages that don't reflect the state I left the property in.

I don't have any reference number from your firm as I haven't been in touch before - this is a new enquiry. I do have the tenancy agreement and move-out photos ready to send over.

Best,
Priya Kaur
